base_selection: Best matching first-parent revision; 309 revisions compared
review: Aurora merged Horizon main of 2026-11-09 (21a7505) on top of the 2026-11-07 nightly. Upstream moved the game loop out of game.rs into game/*.rs (launch options, play input, pointer capture, inventory input, render settings, loading screen, resource loader, loading window); Aurora's Android paths were carried into those files. Taken from upstream: the settings shell and graphics screen, surface_setup.rs, the TerrainWire varying packing (Aurora's GLES lowering no longer packs varyings), the older-servers protocol adapter (1.20.2-26.2), Discord behind its feature. Kept for Android: the touch, keypad and gamepad input (upstream's unused port of Starling's input is not wired), the launcher's mod browser and installed list, Horizon Boost readout in the graphics screen, GLES terrain and entity lowering, compatibility mode and opaque surfaces. The older-servers adapter is on by default on Android with a launcher switch. cargo check passed on arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86 and x86_64, and the shader check (tools/test_android_wgsl.py) passed; device testing of this merge is pending.

accounts_appearance_review.notes: Reviewed newer account-save reporting and desktop encrypted-file storage changes. Android retains its Keystore AES/GCM store and reports sign-in save failures through the existing shared task. The selected stable nightly baseline is unchanged; no experimental UI branches were merged.

android_stability_review.notes: Reviewed the current upstream loading handoff: it still leaks its resource owner for the process lifetime and has no Android lifecycle or GLES preparation path to transplant. Retained the Android baseline; this change owns resources per session, publishes background pause without redraws, and keeps native events flowing during exclusive GLES world preparation. No upstream deployment workflows were enabled.
